needed.evidence: no footway visible, pedestrians walking on road
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the right side of at least 1-metre width and remove obstructions for pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: no footway visible, lack of usable space for pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Install a sidewalk on the left side with a dedicated 1.5-metre width to provide safe walking space.

needed.evidence: marked crossing obstructed and poorly defined, pedestrians crossing in hazard
needed.suggestion: Install traffic signals and introduce a refuge island at this crossing to improve pedestrian safety and ensure motorists stop.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at pedestrian crossing
needed.suggestion: Provide kerb ramps or a raised platform at the crossing to create a level and accessible crossing for pedestrians with disabilities and ease visibility for motorists.

needed.evidence: inadequate lighting along the street, particularly where visible in frames
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lamps spaced every 30 metres along the road to enhance visibility and safety for both pedestrians and motorists.
